name: curve-cam
why: A closed cam r = 20 + 3 cos t + sin 2t drawn from the bare function at 0.00005 mm, 8 tall: (1/2) * integral of r^2 over a turn is 405 pi, so 3240 pi = 10178.760 mm3, which the mesh reads 0.03 % under at 0.01 mm. With no derivative and no fourth-derivative bound the script can only estimate, and says so: curve_bound is estimated, read off the function between the pieces' ends. The points are the function at t = 0 and pi/2, where pieces meet, and at t = 4, inside a piece, all on the boundary - which the probe calls within 0.0001 mm, so a tolerance of 0.001 would put t = 4 outside, as it did -, and at t = 0 1 mm inside and outside along the radius (r(0) = 23).
